_about: Labeled evaluation corpus for the review-pass decision. Each entry states the task text, whether a non-Claude review pass SHOULD be required, and the scope it should carry. Run `npm run eval` to measure precision, recall and the confusion matrix against it. The operational rule: never patch a false positive or false negative without first adding it here, so the fix is measured rather than assumed. Entries marked known_gap:true are cases the classifier is currently expected to get WRONG; they are counted separately and reported, not hidden.

_fields.text: the task description, as a caller would write it
_fields.review: true if an outside review pass should be required
_fields.scope: security or correctness when review is true, null otherwise
_fields.known_gap: optional. true when the classifier is currently expected to get this wrong; documented in docs/KNOWN-LIMITATIONS.md
_fields.note: optional. why this case exists, usually which review round found it
